name.ja: ゴーストリック・スパンキー

text.en: Cannot be Normal Summoned, unless you control a "Ghostrick" monster. When your opponent activates a monster effect on the field (Quick Effect): You can Special Summon this card from your hand in face-down Defense Position, and if you do, place 1 "Ghostrick" Field Spell or "Ghostrick" Continuous Trap from your hand or Deck face-up on your field, then if your opponent has 5 or more cards in their GY, you can Special Summon 1 monster from your hand in face-down Defense Position. Once per turn: You can change this card to face-down Defense Position.
